name: Chopart Joint Injury / Midtarsal Dislocation
definition: Injury of the talonavicular and calcaneocuboid joints, ranging from sprain to fracture-dislocation and potentially affecting midfoot alignment.

investigations.principle: Radiographs and CT define joint alignment and associated fractures.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Urgent foot/ankle specialist review for unstable injury
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-Sandhi injury phenotype may be documented after modern stability assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Injury of the talonavicular and calcaneocuboid joints, ranging from sprain to fracture-dislocation and potentially affecting midfoot alignment.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, sepsis, pathological instability or other listed red flags.
